thread:
marie: Hey team — customer onboarding question. They want three export options: Splunk HEC, S3 exports with SSE-KMS, and a realtime webhook. Need quick answers on schema backwards-compat, KMS error transparency, and SIEM format support (CEF/LEEF). Also they asked if we can include a sample event they can validate against.

sam: For schema tolerance — we should version at the top level (audit_schema_v). We must keep existing required fields stable; new fields are additive and documented. Splunk HEC expects JSON, so adding fields won't break ingestion unless customers have rigid props parsing. Recommend: default v1 and opt-in v2 with a header `X-Audit-Schema: v2`. :+1:

ben: KMS notes — when S3 SSE-KMS encryption fails we currently surface a 500 to internal logs. For customer-facing we should return a structured error like:
```
{
  "error_code": "kms:KeyNotFound",
  "message": "SSE-KMS key arn:aws:kms:... not accessible",
  "remediation": "check-kms-policy",
  "trace_id": "<trace>"
}
```
That lets onboard playbooks show actionable remediation. Also add a metric for kms_decrypt_errors for paging.

jess: Webhook / SIEM formats — most customers use JSON -> SIEM mapping on their side. If they need CEF/LEEF, we can provide a transform layer as an opt-in delivery format. Suggest flags on customer config: `emit_format: json|cef|leef` and `schema_version`. We should also include an example mapping for Datadog & Splunk out of box. I'll draft the transforms. :eyes:

marie: Good. Quick sample event the customer can validate against (minimal):
```
{
  "audit_schema_v": "1",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T17:12:03Z",
  "event_type": "model.deploy",
  "actor": {
    "id": "user-789",
    "type": "user",
    "email": "eng@example.com"
  },
  "resource": {
    "id": "model-123",
    "name": "gpt-mini",
    "version": "v3"
  },
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": {
    "region": "us-west-2",
    "runtime": "dedicated"
  }
}
```

sam: For Splunk specifically, add a `host` and `sourcetype` in our S3/HEC exporter metadata so customers can set props/transforms on ingestion. Also include an option to wrap events in an envelope for non-ndjson consumers.

ben: On the delivery side — webhook retries should include well-defined idempotency: `delivery_id` and `attempt` in the payload envelope. If webhook auth fails (401/403) we should surface the exact upstream response in the UI and include a link to remediation docs.

jess: Onboarding checklist (high level):
- Confirm export target (HEC URL or S3 bucket + prefix)
- KMS key ARN + permission test (we run a kms:Encrypt test)
- Webhook URL + HMAC secret for verification
- Desired emit_format and schema_version
- Sample event validation (we provide test-run endpoint)
I'll add to the onboarding doc and include a small curl test.

marie: Can someone create a short status checklist PR? We need: schema header switch, KMS error shape, webhook envelope fields, and transforms doc for CEF. Tagging @jess to own transforms.

audit-bot: export-job customer-789 queued (job_id=job-992) — will run validation tests against provided sample.

marie: Thanks — I'll reply to the customer with the sample and the checklist. If we can land the KMS error shape and the HEC metadata this week that'd be ideal. :+1:
